question: What limit headers does a real new Free key receive, and do 500 a day, 25 an hour and 3 a second still hold for it?
why: unverified: behind a sign-up. Tomorrow.io's support article (updated 2025-06-11) and FAQ pages state those limits and the pages are unchanged, but the Home Assistant integration docs say the daily count varies by account and assume 100 a day, a 2024 GitHub discussion (timmo001/weather.timmo.dev #21) records one account raised to 499 an hour, the legacy docs host docs.developer.tomorrow.io still shows a Developer plan of up to 1K daily calls, and docs.tomorrow.io/reference/rate-limiting says limit headers are Enterprise-only. The keyless Timelines answer lists per-plan counters (x-ratelimit-remaining-plan-60d46beae90c3b3549a59ff3: 3, the planid of the Free-plan sign-up links; x-ratelimit-remaining-plan-648b3f22ef567da8b7fb4599: 3, the planid of the bare sign-up page) that may be per-second limits; reading the real headers once with a free key would settle it.
